Investigated directly (live sweepScheduleRow call, not assumed): takeoff.csv's own 'refused' status here encodes NEW-WORK TAKEOFF SCOPE exclusion ('(E)AC-1' is existing equipment referenced only in a NATURAL GAS CALCULATION load-accounting table, correctly excluded from a new-installed-quantity count), NOT a drawability claim -- a real, different semantic question than rowsym's 'does a symbol with this canonical identity exist on a plan sheet'. sweepScheduleRow('EAC-1') normalizes to canonical key 'AC-1' (the pipeline treats an '(E)'/'E'-existing-equipment prefix as not part of the identity) and correctly finds a real, distinct, genuinely-installed 'AC-1' unit drawn 42 times on sheet #54 plus 3 more sheets -- a real symbol under this normalized identity does exist, so 'resolved' is the semantically correct rowsym expectation even though it is almost certainly a DIFFERENT physical unit than the specific existing-equipment line item '(E)AC-1' names in the gas-calc table. Corrected from refused (wrongly carried over from takeoff.csv's new-work-scope meaning) to resolved (rowsym's drawability meaning) after this direct investigation.
